answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
